values: 一名具有破坏力的法师，脆弱却能够造成大量伤害。
A destructive Mage who is feeble but skilled at dealing high damage.
哎呀呀，看起来有人要暖和暖和了。
Oh my... Looks like someone needs a little warming up.
My flame burns even more beautifully now..
Hah... All things...must turn to ash someday...
敌人？抱歉哦，不小心都烧掉了~
Sorry, did I burn everything down? Oh well!
Do you need a fire started?
Don't worry, my flames will never hurt you~.
Be careful. If you play with fire, you might get burned~.
火焰呢？不小心的话，可是会灼伤手哟。
Oh? Did you need something, my dear?
合心意的礼物会让火焰燃烧得更加旺盛……也会出卖人心。
A gift chosen with heart adds fuel to the flames... and may uncover the secrets within.
终于又收到你的礼物了……真让人怀念。
A gift from you again at last feels so... nostalgic.
从余烬中出现，如火焰般绽放。
Rising from the glowing embers, blossoming like radiant flames.
淬火而生的钻石，才能拥有最耀眼的光芒。
Only the vow tested and forged in hardship can shine the brightest.
外观商城购买可得该皮肤。
Let me take a breather here.
I wonder what my dear magister is doing now.
How about making this holiday a little warmer?
I adore the vibe of this place!
米瑞尔喜欢烟花，经常不经允许，就把自己的魔法混入烟花表演之中。
Mirael loves fireworks. She often mixes her magic into firework shows, with or without permission.
米瑞尔幼时家中的后院里有许多小坟墓，埋葬的都是被她失控烧毁的玩具。

There's a tiny graveyard behind Mirael's childhood home of her toys, all of which were incinerated when she lost control of her powers. One gravestone says, "Here lies Mr. Tomatohead. Thank you for protecting me from the monster in the closet."
虽身负灰烬魔女之名，米瑞尔却很受农民的喜爱，因为她不仅能击败侵扰的魔物，还能把荒地变成现成的肥田。

Although she's known by her ominous moniker as the Scarlet Sorceress, Mirael is actually very well-liked by the farmers that live in her town. She's been known to defeat dangerous Hypofiends and turn barren land into fertile fields.
米瑞尔入学莱希拉姆魔法学院时，曾经遭到非议，作为其导师的梅林摆平了这件事。
Mirael's admission into the Serene Lyceum was heavily scrutinized by the faculty until Magister Merlin spoke up and she was allowed to attend.
魔药学的安全规章制度最近一次完善是由米瑞尔提出的，她因此受到学校破格嘉奖。

The most recent improvement of the safety protocols for potion-making was proposed by Mirael, for which she received a commendation from the Lyceum. "She's the brightest mage of her age I've ever met," said her potions professor.
虽然米瑞尔对过去在莱希拉姆求学的经历只字不提，但她从未摘下胸口的优秀毕业生勋章。
Although Mirael never mentions her days at the Lyceum, she never takes off her Outstanding Student Award medal and can be found cleaning it on occasion.
莱希拉姆魔法学院的校史馆，目前仍收藏着被米瑞尔退回的皇家魔法师任职邀请函。

The Serene Lyceum has its own school history museum. In there, one will find an imperial invitation. "Dear Ms. Mirael, the Lightbearer Empire would like to extend to you an invitation to become a Royal Magister of the Imperial Court..." She refused.
米瑞尔腰间的爆炸药剂十分不稳定，一直以来她都在吸收着濒临爆发的能量，以此避免爆炸，却在众人眼中成了随身携带有害物的危险分子。

The explosive vial worn at Mirael's side is extremely unstable. She's been absorbing the explosive energy to prevent a destructive explosion. Most people think she is dangerous because of the substances she carries, but she's always in control.
王都附近有一处废墟，是米瑞尔击退大魔物造成的，据说炽热的气息至今仍萦绕在焦黑的残垣上，至今无人敢修复修复。

There are ruins outside the imperial capital, which were created when Mirael repelled a huge Hypofiend. It's said that charred ruins still smolder to this day, and no one dares go near them for fear of being turned to ash.
有一栋农舍起火，路过的米瑞尔随手把火焰引到了空中制成一个火球，借此扑灭了大火，却被村民误认为是始作俑者。她笑着认下，在恐惧的目光里离开了。

Passing by a farmhouse engulfed in flames, Mirael took the flames and shaped them into a fireball, swiftly bringing an end to the fire. The villagers mistook her for the culprit. She simply smiled at their fearful faces before taking her leave.
按照我设想的原理，火焰其实也可以流动吧？
According to my theory, fire should actually flow, right?
Let me take a breather here.
外面居然下起雪来了，倒是很有氛围嘛。
It's actually starting to snow outside. This really sets the mood.
How about making this holiday a little warmer?
I adore the vibe of this place!
